g.aria-label: Integration by Parts (Reversing the Product Rule (uv)′ = u′v + uv′)
∫_a^b u(x) v′(x) dx = [u(x) v(x)]_a^b − ∫_a^b u′(x) v(x) dx
Shifts a derivative off v′ onto u′ at the cost of a boundary term [uv]_a^b
Stein's Identity for the Gaussian Bell w(z) = e^{−z²/2} (where w′(z) = −z w(z))
For Z ~ N(0, 1): E[Z g(Z)] = E[g′(Z)] ⇒ g(z)=z gives E[Z²]=1; g(z)=z³ gives E[Z⁴]=3E[Z²]=3!
